q: By December 31, 2026, European Council conclusions (including those of the special summit on November 26–27 and the December summit) approve a new, named funding instrument with a stated euro amount for Ukraine's 2027 financing needs, separate from the €90 billion loan already approved
basis: At their October summit, EU leaders asked the European Commission to find roughly €70 billion for Ukraine in 2027, and they will take up the question alongside the next long-term budget at a special summit on November 26–27. Hungary's April 2026 election eased the obstacles to unanimity. Still, writing an amount and an instrument into the conclusions is a high bar, and the €90 billion loan was not agreed until December 2025. A yes would be a signal against a pullback in European support (an external variable, 30 percent).
